user.title: Shower Active
user.description: Set up the Shower Active integration. Add individual shower sensors via Options after creating the entry.

data.name: Shower name (e.g. Kids Shower)
data.rise: Turn on when humidity rises this many points above its lowest reading of the last 20 minutes (default 8)
data.min_humidity: Never turn on below this humidity % (default 60)
data.drop: Turn off when humidity falls this many points below the shower's peak (default 3)
data.quiet_minutes: Turn off after this many minutes with no new peak (default 15)
data.max_minutes: Always turn off this many minutes after turning on (default 60)
